text: dsh-file-panel（DSH 网页插件）：在会话中集中查看智能体创建或下载的文件。它在网页界面右侧提供会话文件面板，通过宿主跟踪器记录工具写入和工作目录中新出现的文件，并以轮询方式更新列表。主要功能包括图片和文本内联预览、调用系统应用打开文件、在文件管理器中定位文件、复制绝对路径，以及打开会话工作目录。面板支持拖动、调整大小和自动弹出设置。适合希望在 DSH 网页会话中快速找到并检查产出文件的用户；无需 API 密钥或额外账号。

dsh-file-panel tracks files created or downloaded in a DSH session and lists them in a web side panel. Users can preview images and text, open files or their folder, copy paths, and open the workspace. The panel can pop up for new files and be moved or resized. No API key is needed.
想在 DSH 会话里快速找到刚生成或下载的文件。
能不能在网页侧栏预览智能体做出来的图片和文本？
让 DSH 自动显示会话中新出现的文件。
我想从当前会话直接打开产出的文件或它所在的文件夹。
有没有办法复制智能体生成文件的完整路径？
下载完文件后，怎么在 DSH 里查看它的内容？
Show me the files my DSH session has created or downloaded.
Can I preview generated images and text in the web interface?
dsh-file-panel 的功能「会话文件列表」：面板通过跟踪工具写入事件和监听会话工作目录，按会话显示新近出现的文件，并在文件变化后刷新列表。
dsh-file-panel 的功能「内联预览」：点击文件行可预览图片或文本；文本最多读取 256 KB，图片最多读取 8 MB，其他类型显示无内联预览提示。
dsh-file-panel 的功能「系统打开与定位」：文件操作可调用系统默认应用打开文件，或在文件管理器中显示文件；界面也提供复制绝对路径。
dsh-file-panel 的功能「可调整的自动弹出面板」：新文件到达时，面板可按偏好自动展开；用户可拖动或调整面板大小，界面状态保存在浏览器本地存储。

dsh-file-panel README · dsh-file-panel：[](https://github.com/yu2025-luo/dsh-file-panel/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE)

A plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh` web GUI) that watches what the agent creates and downloads during a session, and shows it in a **right-side popup panel** — like the file viewer in Codex.

When a file or image is written to disk during a session, the panel pops up automatically on the right. Every row lets you:

dsh-file-panel README · dsh-file-panel：- 👁 **Preview** — images render inline; text files show their first 256 KB; other types show metadata.
- 📂 **Show in folder** — opens the OS file manager with the file selected (`explorer.exe /select` on Windows, `open -R` on macOS, `xdg-open` on Linux).
- ↗ **Open** — opens the file with the OS default application (via the harness's built-in `host.openPath` RPC).
- 📋 **Copy path** — copies the absolute path to the clipboard.

dsh-file-panel README · dsh-file-panel：Also ships a **workspace folder** shortcut at the bottom of the panel.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

dsh-file-panel README · Screenshots：*The right-docked session files panel: every row previews, opens, reveals, or copies its path; the bottom button opens the session's working directory. The panel is fully draggable (grab the header) and resizable from its left and bottom edges, with scrollbars appearing when it gets narrow.*
dsh-file-panel README · Installation：Requires DeepSeek Harness `dsh` CLI (npm package `@deepseek-ai/dsh`) and pnpm.

dsh-file-panel README · From a local checkout：```sh
cd dsh-file-panel
npm install          # installs esbuild (dev-only)
npm run build        # produces lib/index.js + lib/client.js (committed)

dsh-file-panel README · register in the web profile (link: tracks your checkout live)：dsh plugin --profile web add link:.
```

dsh-file-panel README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yu2025-luo/dsh-file-panel
```

The built artifacts are committed, so no build step runs during install.

dsh-file-panel README · Activate：Restart the `dsh web` server (plugin sets take effect on restart), then refresh
`http://127.0.0.1:3080`. That's it — no configuration required.

Remove with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-file-panel
```

dsh-file-panel README · Usage：| Gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Agent creates/downloads a file | Panel pops up automatically (newest files carry a `NEW` chip) |
| Click a row | Inline preview (image / text / metadata) |
| Row hover actions | Preview, open, show in folder, copy path |
| 🔔 bell | Toggle auto-pop for new files |
| `–` / `×` | Collapse to a floating launcher button (with new-file badge) or hide |
| Bottom "open workspace folder" | Opens the session's working directory |

dsh-file-panel README · Usage：Panel state (open/collapsed) and the auto-pop preference persist in
`localStorage`. The auto-pop baseline is per session: files that already
existed when the panel first saw the session do not re-trigger a popup.

dsh-file-panel README · How it works：One npm package with two halves, registered as a single loader row
(`cordis.patch.yml` → row `file-panel`):

```
Host half (src/index.js)                     Browser half (src/client.jsx)
────────────────────────                     ──────────────────────────────
ctx.on('fs/observed')          ──┐
  write/edit tools report        │            shell.overlay slot entry:

dsh-file-panel README · How it works：The client half registers into the shipped `shell.overlay` slot (additive,
frame-wide floating layer), reads the current session through the standard
`useSessions` prop, and polls the plugin's own loopback-only RPC channel.
The channel is registered with `ctx.connection.rpc.handle`, the sanctioned
static-package RPC seam.

dsh-file-panel README · Security：- The `/file-panel` channel is registered with `authority: 'loopback'`, so
  only pages served from `127.0.0.1` can call it. When the GUI is accessed
  over the network (`--trusted-host`), the panel shows a notice and stays
  inactive.
- Every read/reveal endpoint only accepts absolute paths that the tracker
  has actually seen (a tool write or a watcher event under a watched working
  directory) — the RPC can never be used as a generic file-read/reveal
  primitive.

dsh-file-panel README · Project layout：```
src/
  index.js      host half: tracker wiring + /file-panel RPC endpoints
  tracker.js    pure-Node file tracker (fs/observed ingestion, recursive
                watcher with debounce, ignore rules, caps, RPC fence)

dsh-file-panel README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build   # rebuild lib/index.js and lib/client.js
npm test        # node --test
```

For a fast client-side iteration loop after changing `src/client.jsx`:

```sh
npm run build
```

dsh-file-panel README · Development：then hard-refresh the GUI page (`lib/client.js` is served with
`cache-control: no-cache`; plugin *sets* only change on restart, but bundle
*content* re-hashes per request — see `dsh-client-modules`). During active
UI development you can also run `pnpm run dev:web` from the harness checkout
to rebuild client bundles on change.

dsh-file-panel README · Compatibility：Built against the public seams of `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.x`:

- host: `ctx.connection.rpc.handle` / `ctx.on('fs/observed')`
- client: `shell.overlay` slot, `useSessions` standard prop,
  `ctx.connection.rpc.call`, `ctx.locale`

DeepSeek Harness is pre-release: those seams may move. If the panel stops
working after a `dsh` upgrade, check the pinned version in
`package.json` and re-run the build.

dsh-file-panel README · Known limitations：- The recursive watcher uses `fs.watch({ recursive: true })` (Node ≥ 20).
  On platforms where that is unavailable, the panel still tracks everything
  the harness `write`/`edit` tools produce, but shell-side downloads may be
  missed.
- The panel is process-local: it starts empty after a restart (it only
  records files it actually observed; it does not scan history).
- `node_modules`, `.git`, and temporary-file noise are ignored by design.
- `reveal` on headless Linux reports `canReveal: false` and hides the
  button (no desktop to open).

dsh-file-panel README · Publishing to GitHub / npm：1. Create a GitHub repo and push (the repo is already a git repository with
   a `v0.1.4` tag):

```sh
   git remote add origin https://github.com/yu2025-luo/dsh-file-panel.git
   git push -u origin main --tags
   ```

dsh-file-panel README · Publishing to GitHub / npm：2. Add the [`dsh-plugin` topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) on the
   repo page (About → gear icon → Topics) together with
   `deepseek-harness`, `dsh`, `deepseek`, and `file-preview`. The repo then
   appears on the public plugin topic page automatically.
3. Users install with
   `dsh plugin --profile web add github:yu2025-luo/dsh-file-panel#v0.1.4`.
4. Optionally publish to npm (`npm publish`) — then install with
   `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-file-panel`.

dsh-file-panel README · Publishing to GitHub / npm：Community catalogs that sync from the `dsh-plugin` topic:
[Oh-My-DSH](https://github.com/like-study1/Oh-My-DSH) (auto-synced) and
[awesome-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness)
(PR-based).

Remember to bump the version and re-run `npm run build` before releasing.
